schema_doc: Canonical paragraph-level corrections registry. Source of truth for all manual edits applied on top of the immutable FB2 source. Pipeline: fb2_remake.fb2 → parse → text_corrections.json → apply → remake_data.js / book_text.md.

version_history.v1 → v2: Major reconciliation pass after ChatGPT 5.5 + Gemini 3.1 Pro parallel audits (Apr 2026). Removed 3 spurious pending items (§13 stamina+15, §140 gold+30, §532 wound_2 — first two were misinterpretations of paragraph-arithmetic mechanics, third was already implemented in src/remake_data.js + src/game_logic.js). Corrected §166 canonical branch set. Registered ~25 new pending items across 4 categories: gold-sign data bugs, missing passive auto-effects, missing item acquisitions, conditional-choice gating, and the dynamic-target paragraph-arithmetic engine cluster.
version_history.v2 → v2.1: May 2026 sweep against current MJ_MAP and art_catalog.py state revealed that all Group 4 art-mapping recommendations from both audits were already in place: §1072 already maps to art09_sleeping_princess; art12_camp/art29_hostess/art41_mounted catalogues already match MJ_MAP; §319/§100/§558/§846/§1123 already use the recommended arts. The audits were taken before previous sessions had already cleaned up these mappings. Items recorded in resolved_no_op below as verified-and-resolved so future audits don't resurrect them.
version_history.v2.1 → v2.2: May 2026 mid-session sweep: registered three findings discovered while applying Group 1 deferred (white arrow) and Group 6 (Vodyanoy paradox). Each is a non-blocker but should not be lost: §874 silver bracelet has no acquisition path; bronze whistle is granted under three different name strings; §1122 partial inventory loss (knives) is narrative-only. Added as pending groups 11, 12, 13.
version_history.v2.2 → v2.3: May 2026 investigation deepened group_11 (silver bracelet). FB2 search confirmed there is no auto-acquisition paragraph for 'Серебряный браслет'. The item is purchased from the peasant's shop in §340 along with 8 other items. §340 in remake_data.js has the FB2 text describing the shop but no purchase mechanism — only 3 navigation choices (leave west / south / stay). This is a symptom of a missing shop/buy-choice engine feature, not a single-paragraph fix. Group 11 reclassified as architectural; new group_14 added to track the shop-mechanic gap across the book.
version_history.v2.3 → v2.4: May 2026 — Group 12 (bronze whistle) partially closed: 2 name rationalizations applied + 3 offer-paragraphs gated by inventory_condition. The post-combat acquisition half of group_12 (7 paragraphs where the player kills a goblin and then takes the whistle from the corpse) cannot be closed without a new engine feature, because auto_items applies on first paragraph entry, before combat resolves. Registered as new group_15.
version_history.v2.4 → v2.5: May 2026 — group_13 reclassified after FB2 verification. The Gemini graph audit had read the §1122 «ножей и след простыл» line as inventory loss of knife-class items, but FB2 review shows the knives were never inventory items at all — they were an attack effect from a previous trap paragraph causing wounds. The §1122 effect is the canonical −5 STAMINA cost the canon states explicitly («вычесть 5 ВЫНОСЛИВОСТЕЙ за те раны»), so this is a Group 1.3-class missing auto-effect, not a Group 7-class inventory loss. Applied auto_items.stamina_sub=5 and moved registry entry from pending_corrections to resolved_no_op with the corrected interpretation. The lose_substring engine extension idea originally floated in group_13 is no longer needed for this paragraph (and there are no other knife-loss paragraphs in the data either).
version_history.v2.5 → v2.6: May 2026 — registry hygiene sweep. Seven groups had been closed by commits across the recent sessions but were still listed in pending_corrections, making the backlog look bigger than it is. Closed groups now carry status_done with their commit hashes. Two diagnostic-only groups (9 combat balance, 10 spell economy) moved to resolved_no_op as design notes — not bugs. Net effect: pending_corrections now lists only items that genuinely need future work.
version_history.v2.6 → v2.7: May 2026 — group_15 (post-combat item grants) closed. New engine field 'acquires' added to choice schema: a choice may carry an item name (string) or array of names, deposited into S.inventory when the player clicks the button. Uses existing showInventoryModal for 7-slot overflow handling. Applied to 6 paragraphs (§58, §69, §233, §250, §567, §717). Three of those also gained the missing post_combat:true flag so the button only appears after combat resolves. Smoke-test scenarios extended to cover all 6.
version_history.v2.7 → v2.8: May 2026 — user manual smoke-test found 3 conditional-gating regressions that slipped through Group 3 / Group 1.4 work: §412, §464 (both rope), §725 (gold whistle). Fixed in same commit. Also found two related patterns that need separate work: §774 has gold-amount conditional choices (1g and 5g checks) that require a new gold_condition mechanism, and §1208 has 'если у вас есть фигурный ключ' but no paragraph in the data grants 'Фигурный ключ' (same class as silver bracelet group_11). Registered as group_16 and group_17.
version_history.v2.8 → v2.9: May 2026 — group_14 (shop / buy-choice engine) closed. New engine mechanism: purchase:true flag on choice, with gold_cost, grants_items, and grants_stamina fields. Bought items tracked in S.shopBought[para] so same item can't be bought twice; food (grants_stamina without items) is consumable, unlimited buys until gold runs out. Applied to §340 (peasant shop, 9 items: 3 food + 6 inventory items). This unblocks group_11 (silver bracelet — granted by §340 at 4g) and group_17 (figurine key — granted by §340 at 2g). Both consumer paragraphs (§1090 ch[1], §1208 ch[0]) now gated by inventory_condition. §873 (Vodyanoy tavern) NOT migrated — its food choices are narrative drink/eat with stat effects and one trap branch; different mechanic. Kept as-is.
version_history.v2.9 → v2.10: May 2026 — group_16 (gold-condition gating) closed. Two new engine fields: gold_condition:N (visibility gate, button hidden if S.gold<N) and gold_cost:N (deducted on click, before navigation). Both compose with existing inventory_condition, acquires, purchase. Applied to §774 (3 gates + 1 inventory_condition) and §686 ch[0] (gate + cost for 'кинуть ещё 4 золотых'). Also registered new finding group_18: §774 FB2 text lists 'красивый кусочек дерева' as one of 4 hatch-opening options but no choice exists for it. Pattern: missing-choice, similar class as the silver bracelet/key branches except the data already has §340 granting the item — just §774 doesn't expose the choice.
version_history.v2.10 -> v2.11: May 2026 - group_18 (missing wood-piece choice at sec.774) closed. sec.774 ch[0] label rewritten from the generic 'Poprobovat otkryt dver podhodyaschim predmetom' to the specific wood-piece variant, and gated by inventory_condition='Krasivyi kusochek dereva'. Matches the FB2 canon where the wood piece is one of 4 explicit hatch-opening options. Item is grantable via sec.340 shop (1 gold) since commit ab5e585.
version_history.v2.11 -> v2.12: May 2026 — Group 6 (paragraph-arithmetic mechanics) started. fish_help (item 1 of 13) closed via existing inventory_condition + acquires machinery, no new universal engine hook (per group_6 warning about 1221-renumbering breaking arithmetic). sec.13 grants "Помощь рыбки" via acquires on the throw-fish-back choice (not on sec.195 put-in-bag path). Three consumers gated: sec.32→sec.47, sec.203→sec.218, sec.699→sec.714. sec.698→sec.713 rejected after FB2 verification. Engine: dead-end check in renderGame generalised from raw 0 choices to filtered 0 choices, so inventory-gated dead-ends route to the death overlay correctly when the player has no token. This generalisation is reusable for all remaining 12 group_6 items.
version_history.v2.12 -> v2.13: May 2026 — Group 6 item 2 of 13 (gold_key) closed as verification-only. No engine or data changes — the work was already shipped across two prior commits: 9b2f60b (sec.1085 inventory_condition gating, group_4) and cce1a1f (sec.140 / sec.440 / sec.1172 acquisition grants, group_3). FB2 sweep confirms no additional gold-key consumer doors in the canon. sec.140 has no auto_items by design (reachable only via sec.440 which already grants the key). One new smoke-test scenario added for the sec.1172 alternate-route acquisition path (dragon-route victory).
version_history.v2.13 -> v2.14: May 2026 — Group 6 item 3 of 13 (candle_lamp) closed via inventory_condition + acquires machinery (no new engine hook, consistent with fish_help approach). sec.929 grants "Свеча" via new acquires field on its single nav choice; sec.600 already grants the same name via pre-existing auto_items. Two consumers gated: sec.696→sec.706 (corridor light), sec.1000→sec.1010 (post-Goblins darkness lift). sec.972→sec.982 explicitly rejected (fail-route belonging to the separate Подсвечник item-offer mechanism). FB2 sweep confirms no other +10 consumers exist in the canon for this item family.
version_history.v2.14 -> v2.15: May 2026 — Group 6 item 4 of 13 (figured_key) closed. Audit found figured_key has NO +40 arithmetic mechanic in the FB2 canon — the registry +40 quote was misattributed (canonical +40 at sec.487 belongs to a separate ring/перстень item). figured_key is functionally a shop-purchase item gated via inventory_condition. Acquisitions and two of three consumer gating already shipped in groups 14/16/17. This commit fixes the third consumer at sec.804 (figured-key choice to sec.895 was missing inventory_condition gating — a regression that showed the figured-key option to players without the key). Documented a future-cleanup task: create a new ring-key item entry for the sec.487 +40 mechanic.
version_history.v2.15 -> v2.16: May 2026 — Group 6 item 5 of 13 (castle_key) closed. Acquisition sec.471 already shipped via auto_items granting "Ключ Чёрного замка". Four canonical +40 consumer doors gated via inventory_condition: sec.91→sec.131 (sentry tower), sec.687→sec.727 (stairwell), sec.694→sec.734 (corridor to sec.671), sec.768→sec.808 (stairwell to sec.1150). Three previously-suggested consumers rejected: sec.70→sec.110 (monster trap), sec.393→sec.433 (door not locked), sec.1074→sec.1114 (canon-locked even with key). No new engine work — reuses existing inventory_condition machinery.
version_history.v2.16 -> v2.17: May 2026 — Group 6 item 6 of 13 (bear_key) closed. Registry had two transcription errors: modifier "+400" wrong (canonical sec.612 says +40), and item-state name implied single-acquisition but FB2 has TWO routes (bear-gift sec.612 + goblin-loot sec.69 / sec.233 / sec.567). Unified inventory name to "Медный ключик" (sec.612 auto_items renamed from bare "Ключ"). Two canonical +40 consumers wired: sec.851→sec.891, sec.881→sec.921 — both target paragraphs were ORPHANED in remake. Two regression fixes: sec.803→sec.1035 and sec.804→sec.1064 were unconditional in remake despite source narratives saying "если у вас есть медный ключик" / "может быть, есть медный ключик" — both now gated. Two +40 mappings rejected (sec.899→sec.939 unrelated dialog, sec.962→sec.1002 anti-pattern with key-breaking).
version_history.v2.17 -> v2.18: May 2026 — Group 6 item 7 of 13 (candle_set) marked status_deprecated after comprehensive FB2 audit. The registry-claimed +20/+100 mechanic and "Возьми подсвечник" quote are absent from the remake 1221-paragraph canon: 0 paragraphs mention white/black candles, 0 contain "прибавьте 20" or "прибавьте 100", 0 contain "Возьми подсвечник". The mechanic was either a 1991-original artifact dropped in the remake or an audit cross-talk hallucination. The light-source family is fully served by candle_lamp (commit 1c57f48) and the separate "Подсвечник" item-offer consumer at sec.972 / sec.34. No data, engine, smoke-test, or build changes — this is an audit-only deprecation commit.
version_history.v2.18 -> v2.19: May 2026 — Group 6 item 8 of 13 (thread_ball) closed. Registry had one transcription error: modifier "-50" should be "+50" (canonical sec.198 says "прибавляйте 50", positive). Acquisition sec.198 grants "Клубочек" via new acquires field on its only nav choice. Three canonical +50 consumers wired via inventory_condition: sec.108→sec.158, sec.366→sec.416, sec.401→sec.451. Seven of ChatGPT v4's ten candidates rejected after narrative verification — including the most egregious sec.1170→sec.1220 (final victory paragraph). Klubochek is reusable; sec.747 fail-trap mechanic (klubochek loss in forest) is canonically already wired without group_6 changes.
version_history.v2.19 -> v2.20: May 2026 — Group 6 item 9 of 13 (ruby_ring) closed. Most narratively important group_6 closure to date: restores the canonical Princess wake-up at sec.627 which was previously orphan. Registry had conflated THREE ring items into one entry; sec.1071 "Перстень с рубином" +401 now correctly wired with auto_items on acquisition and inventory_condition gating at sec.226. sec.86 disambiguation preserved — emerald ring still canonically useless for Princess wake-up. Follow-up tracked: sec.479 "Перстень с изумрудом" -140 mechanic needs a new group_6 entry (emerald_ring).
version_history.v2.20 -> v2.21: May 2026 — Group 6 item 10 of 13 (ruby_star) closed. sec.791 acquisition previously had no auto_items grant; ruby star never reached inventory. This commit adds auto_items granting "Рубиновая звезда" on entry. Four canonical +71 path-hint consumers wired via inventory_condition: sec.637→sec.708, sec.846→sec.917, sec.934→sec.1005, sec.1082→sec.1153. All four target paragraphs were orphan in remake. FB2 grep for "звезда сияет" / "звезда начинает светиться" identified the exact canonical pairs, all verified with Δ=71 arithmetic and matching source/target narratives.
version_history.v2.21 -> v2.22: May 2026 — Group 6 item 11 of 13 (spell_book) closed. Registry had one transcription error: modifier "+20" should be "+24" (canonical sec.1137 says "прибавьте 24"). Acquisition sec.1137 previously had no auto_items grant; magic book never reached inventory. This commit adds the missing grant. Four canonical +24 decoder consumers wired via inventory_condition: sec.4→sec.28, sec.339→sec.363, sec.732→sec.756, sec.798→sec.822. All four target paragraphs were orphan in remake. FB2 grep methodology: search "расшифр" + "надпис" + verify Δ=24 offset, identical to ruby_star's "звезда" grep approach.
version_history.v2.22 -> v2.23: May 2026 — Group 6 item 12 of 13 (golden_orange) closed. Registry modifier "+750" verified at canonical sec.74. Acquisition already shipped via auto_items. Single canonical +750 consumer sec.226 → sec.976 wired via inventory_condition. sec.976 was orphan in remake. This is the parallel canonical Princess wake-up route — both ruby_ring (sec.627 via +401) and golden_orange (sec.976 via +750) lead to sec.1120/sec.1220 victory routing. Player can hold either or both items and the gating shows the appropriate button.

schema_fields.field: JSON path inside the paragraph object, e.g. 'text', 'choices.label', 'choices[N].label', 'auto_items.gold_sub', or external location like 'src/game_logic.js:PREFACE_TEXT'
schema_fields.original: Exact substring/value as it appeared in the upstream source
schema_fields.source: Audit/PR reference where the issue was identified
schema_fields.type: Optional taxonomy: ocr | typo | missing_space | gameplay_logic | disambiguation | broken_target | sign_bug | missing_auto_effect | missing_item | conditional_choice | dynamic_target | dead_end_crash

group_6_dynamic_target_engine.comment: Paragraph-arithmetic mechanics: text says 'add N to current paragraph number' and routes player to paragraph+N. CRITICAL: cannot be implemented as a universal engine hook because 1221-renumbering of the remake breaks many offsets. Examples: §1085+30=§1115 works, but §385+910=§1295 exceeds 1221, and §198+50=§248 may not be canonical. Each item below requires per-item remap table verified manually against fb2_remake.fb2 + check that consumer paragraphs exist in remake numbering. Architectural recommendation: per-item conditional routing (Approach 3 from Gemini bonus reply), NOT a generic currentParagraph + modifier hook (Approach 2 was Gemini's first suggestion but ChatGPT v3 verified it's unsafe).
group_6_dynamic_target_engine.warning_for_implementer: Do NOT add a universal +N engine hook. Each item below needs its own remap table mapping (acquisition_paragraph → consumer_paragraph(s) → success/fail targets). Verify every consumer target exists in src/remake_data.js before wiring it up.

Without this commit, the game's canonical victory route through sec.627 → sec.1220 is unreachable via the ruby-ring mechanic. Registry "ruby_ring +401" had conflated THREE distinct ring items: sec.487 "Перстень" (+40 doors, already shipped — this is the +40 quote that figured_key audit traced as misattributed), sec.479 "Перстень с изумрудом" (-140, separate item, out of scope here), and sec.1071 "Перстень с рубином" (+401, THIS audit). sec.1071 previously had no auto_items despite narrative "Вы надеваете перстень с рубином" — the ring was worn but never inventoried. sec.226 +401 = sec.627 verified by FB2 narrative match: source says "Если у вас есть волшебный перстень, то вы знаете, что надо делать", target says "свет свечи падает на рубин перстня, и камень оживает". sec.86 confirms ONLY the ruby ring works at sec.226: emerald ring "сейчас бесполезен" for Princess wake-up.

group_14_shop_buy_choice_engine.comment: Several paragraphs across the book describe a shop-style merchant selling multiple items at named prices, but the engine has no purchase choice type. Players read the prices in the text, but the only choices on the screen are navigation. Found via the silver bracelet investigation (group_11) — §340 (peasant) is one such case with 9 items. There are likely others (Vodyanoy's tavern food/water sales in §873 use ad-hoc gold_sub but only on auto_items, not on choice-level purchase). A general shop mechanism would unify these. Architectural design needed before implementation: choice schema extension (new fields on choice: purchase=true, gold_cost=N, grants_items=['...']), engine renderChoices changes (show price in label, gate by S.gold>=cost, deduct gold and add item on click), and per-paragraph data fixes wherever shops occur.

candidate_shop_paragraphs_for_audit.comment: Peasant's shop. Items: ананас 2g, банан 2g, лимон 2g, красивый кусочек дерева 1g, фигурный ключ 2g, попона 5g, блестящий кусок металла 3g, сделанная из золота устрица 8g, серебряный браслет 4g. Currently no purchase choices.

Vodyanoy's tavern. Items: жареная рыба 1g (→§922), родниковая вода 2g (→§767). Has navigation choices but no item grant on those purchases. Less critical because the only food benefit is narrative — but adds inconsistency.

design_open_questions: Should the player be able to make multiple purchases from a single shop paragraph (re-render the shop after each), or are shops one-shot?
Should item label include the price (e.g. 'Серебряный браслет (4g)') or should the price live in choice.gold_cost only?
Re-render after purchase: should the engine track which items have been bought to prevent buying twice from the same shop, or just rely on gold deduction making infinite purchases self-limiting?

status_done.summary: New choice schema fields: purchase:true, gold_cost:N, grants_items:'Name' or array, grants_stamina:N. Engine helpers makePurchaseBtn + completePurchase in src/game_logic.js. Applied to §340 with 9 purchase choices.

group_15_post_combat_item_grants.comment: Several paragraphs use a 'kill enemy, then take their item' pattern. Currently the only way to express this in data is auto_items.items, which applies on first entry — too early, because the player hasn't yet won the combat. Result: the post_combat choice button says 'Взять X и идти дальше' but X never enters inventory. Found during Group 12 (whistle) work, but the pattern is general and applies to every loot-from-corpse scenario in the book. Need new engine feature.
design_options: Option A: new auto_items_after_combat field. Engine applies it when sec.enemies && combatDone[S.section] becomes true, rather than on firstVisit. Symmetric with existing auto_items.

Option B: new acquires field on choice. choice = {target, label, acquires: ['Бронзовый свисток']}. Engine deposits items at the moment the player clicks the choice. More flexible — different post-combat choices could grant different items (e.g. 'take whistle' vs 'leave whistle').
Option C: paragraph splitting — introduce a synthetic intermediate paragraph between combat and the next location, and put auto_items on it. Heavy data refactor; not recommended.

candidate_paragraphs.note: §391 is a post-combat 'обшарив карманы Гоблина, находите бронзовый свисток' — already has auto_items grant in current data because the combat is in a different paragraph. Listed for completeness but not affected.

group_15_post_combat_item_grants.verification_required: Once group_15 is implemented, sweep all post_combat choice labels across remake_data.js for similar 'возьмите/заберите/обыщите' verbs to find every paragraph that needs the new field — there are likely several beyond the whistle list.

status_done.summary: New engine field 'acquires' on choice. Applied to §58 (Бронзовый свисток), §69 (whistle + Медный ключик), §233 (both), §250 (whistle only), §567 (both), §717 (whistle only). §391 already correct via auto_items and not affected.

group_16_gold_condition_gating.comment: Some paragraphs offer the player a choice that costs a specific amount of gold (e.g. §774: 'если есть 1 золотой — открыть дверь монетой', 'если есть 5 золотых — попробовать открыть большой сундук'). The engine has no way to gate a choice by gold-on-hand and no way to deduct the cost on click. Currently the buttons show regardless of gold balance, and clicking does not subtract. Resolution requires a new choice-level field gold_condition:N (button rendered only when S.gold>=N) and gold_cost:N (deduct on click — could reuse acquires' onclick wrapper). Different from group_14 (shop engine) in that this is a single conditional choice, not a full multi-item shop transaction.

group_17_figurine_key_missing_acquisitio.comment: Same class as group_11 (silver bracelet): §1208 ch[0] offers 'если у вас есть фигурный ключ — открыть средний сундук (984)' but no paragraph anywhere in src/remake_data.js grants 'Фигурный ключ' via auto_items.items. The branch is unreachable by rules until either (a) the canonical acquisition paragraph is found in FB2 and added, or (b) it is verified that the item does not exist in canon and the branch is removed. Pattern: same as silver bracelet — FB2 §340 (peasant shop) lists 'фигурный ключ' as one of the 9 items at 2 gold, so resolution is also blocked by group_14 (shop engine). DO NOT remove ch[0] — it will become reachable once the shop mechanic lands.

group_18_missing_choice_§774_wood_piece.comment: FB2 §774 text lists FOUR ways to open the hatch: (a) красивый кусочек дерева → §1132, (b) фигурный ключ → §251, (c) 1 золотой → §686, (d) 5 золотых → §299. Currently §774 in remake_data.js has choices for (b), (c), (d) plus a generic ch[0] labelled 'Попробовать открыть дверь подходящим предметом' targeting §1132 (the wood-piece outcome). The generic label hides the canonical wood-piece option from the player and routes them blindly. Fix: replace ch[0] with a specific wood-piece choice gated by inventory_condition='Красивый кусочек дерева'. Item is grantable via §340 (commit ab5e585). Small fix, P3.

Gemini 3.1 Pro audit flagged §36 (Trader Skill 7 / Stamina 17) and §760 (Bats Skill 4 / Stamina 6–8) as combat outliers. On review these are intentional pacing choices: the trader is a deliberate HP-sponge / mid-game choke point; the bats are a stamina-drain encounter by design. Neither is a bug. Listing as a design note in case a future balance pass revisits individual encounters, but no engine or data work is required.

Gemini 3.1 Pro audit observed that ILLUSION and HEALING spells have only 1–2 uses each across 1221 paragraphs while FIRE and LEVITATION are mandatory. The audit suggested either rebalancing the canon or warning the player at character creation. Both options are out of scope: rebalancing the canon would mean changing the source book; the character-creation warning is a UX feature that belongs in a separate pass and is not registry-tracked. Diagnostic only — no fix planned. Players read the canon and choose accordingly.
